instruction: Write a complete XDP/eBPF C program defining a BPF_MAP_TYPE_ARRAY map named 'pkt_stats' (key __u32, value __u64, max_entries 1). For every packet, look up key 0, atomically increment the counter, and return XDP_PASS.
requirements: Check null pointer on map lookup result before updating

tests.name: count_tcp_packet_pass
tests.description: IPv4 TCP packet counted and passed

tests.name: count_udp_packet_pass
tests.description: IPv4 UDP packet counted and passed

tests.name: count_short_packet_pass
tests.description: Arbitrary short packet counted and passed
